yt_description:
Why does a 2005 Land Rover LR3 have 12 times the complaints of a 2008? 2005 was the first model year: it logged 96 NHTSA complaints and five recalls, against 8 complaints for the 2008. ReRev rates the 2008–09 the most reliable LR3s. Buying a 2005 anyway? Run the VIN and make sure all five recalls were done.

Every LR3 year, with the reasons and sources: https://boxytrucks.com/models/land-rover/lr3/years/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=hook-test

Photos: txomcs / Pexels. Voiceover is AI-generated.
yt_comment: Thanks for watching! On a 2005–06, two recalls to check by VIN: the driver airbag clockspring wiring (NHTSA 08V248000) and the fuel-tank breather pipe (05V376000, then 07V011000).
